verdict.rationale: GA4 has its own documented programmatic surfaces that run without the UI. The Data API is explicitly pitched to 'automate complex reporting tasks', the Admin API automates reading and changing settings, and client libraries cover seven languages. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI or headless operation specifically: no CLI, no CI recipes, and no non-interactive auth such as service accounts. missing for 10: official CLI, documented CI/pipeline usage, headless/service-account authentication guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use the Data API to programmatically access Google Analytics report data.
